_model_execution_boundary_statement: THE MODEL CALL HAPPENS EXCLUSIVELY ON THE HOST AGENT TO REASON AND SELECT TOOLS; THE MCP SERVER NEVER CALLS AN LLM AND ONLY EXECUTES DETERMINISTIC TOOL FUNCTIONS.

annotations.jsonrpc: Identifies the wire transport standard as JSON-RPC 2.0 specification.
annotations.id: Unique request identifier (integer/string) used by the client to correlate asynchronous responses.
annotations.method: MCP lifecycle method 'initialize' sent by the client to negotiate capabilities.
annotations.params: Object containing client metadata, supported protocol version, and optional client capabilities.

annotations.id: Matching request ID (1) confirming this payload responds to the initialize request.
annotations.result: Payload returning negotiated protocolVersion, server feature capabilities (tools), and serverInfo.

annotations.method: One-way lifecycle notification signaling that the client has processed the initialize response and is ready for traffic.
annotations.id: Omitted because notifications do not expect or permit a server response.

annotations.method: Discovery method requesting all callable tools exposed by this MCP server.

tools.name: get_claim_status
tools.description: Retrieves financial amounts, claimant information, and current processing status for an insurance claim.

tools.name: get_adjuster_notes
tools.description: Retrieves detailed adjuster investigation notes and incident observations for a given claim.

annotations.result: Contains the 'tools' array where each entry defines tool name, semantic description (docstring), and JSON-Schema inputSchema.

annotations.method: Execution method 'tools/call' invoking a specific tool on the server.
annotations.params: Contains target tool 'name' and verified dictionary of 'arguments' passed by the host agent.

content.text: {"claim_id": "CLM-7002", "adjuster_notes": "Heavy torrential rainfall caused rising lake water and surface runoff to inundate basement. Excluded flood event under Section 5.2.", "incident_type": "Basement Water Damage", "notes_length": 152}

annotations.result: Contains 'content' array with serialized text payload and boolean 'isError' status flag.
